title: The Moon in the Dry Basin

scenes.title: The Hollow Stone
scenes.text: I tapped the wall with my sword, and one of the stones sounded weird. Then it moved. There were stairs back there.
scenes.direction: Tell a friend what happened. Use your everyday speaking voice.

scenes.title: The Giants on My Cloak
scenes.text: I found this tapestry with giants all over it, so I wore it like a cape. Then I walked into a room with a real one.
scenes.direction: Tell a friend what happened. Use your everyday speaking voice.

scenes.title: The Offer
scenes.speaker: giant
scenes.text: One will take you beyond the castle. Choose.
scenes.direction: Low, almost courteous authority. Leave a beat before “Choose.” Say that last word quietly and with finality.

scenes.title: The Silver Eye
scenes.text: He was watching my hands, but in the tray his reflection was watching the cups. So I knocked them both over. His eye opened like a door. I went through.
scenes.direction: Tell a friend what happened. Use your everyday speaking voice.

scenes.title: The Tide at Moth Wharf
scenes.text: I could see waves in this stone basin, even though it was dry. I messed up the salt around the edge to see what would happen. Nothing.
scenes.direction: Tell a friend what happened. Use your everyday speaking voice.

scenes.title: Three Rising Notes
scenes.text: A tree was humming three notes. I heard the same notes in the rain and found a whistle there. I played them into the tree. It opened.
scenes.direction: Tell a friend what happened. Use your everyday speaking voice.

scenes.title: The Circle of Salt
scenes.text: Under the tree I found a piece of moon with waves in it. Same as the basin. I put it inside a ring of salt. The waves barely moved.
scenes.direction: Tell a friend what happened. Use your everyday speaking voice.

scenes.title: The Way Beneath the Quay
scenes.text: I picked the moon shard back up. This time its reflection fit right into the curve in the basin. The tide pulled back, and there was a path under the dock.
scenes.direction: Tell a friend what happened. Use your everyday speaking voice.

scenes.title: The Reed Chapel
scenes.text: My shadow stopped right at the edge of the drop. I backed up. Then I heard this tapping from the reeds. There was a drum in there.
scenes.direction: Tell a friend what happened. Use your everyday speaking voice.
